finding.text: Server/merge.mjs:~572 reuses `wtBase`, which is null unless `pageUrlFor` returned a url for an added file. A branch that adds only a page the screenshot step skips, with no worktree server, prints "click test skipped" and merges. The gate fails open there. Say so in nav-check.md, or call `worktreeBase(dir)` directly in the nav block.

The diff has no link on the sessions page for `/framework/ai/sessions/v/review/`, and none for `/framework/ai/asks/undone/`. `/framework/ai/sessions/v/`, `/framework/ai/asks/` and `/framework/ai/readmes/` do get a pill. The census list is in session.jsonl, not the diff, so I could not check whether those two are reached from `v/` and `asks/`. The deputy should check that list.
The Live pill row links `/live/` from `/live/` itself (public/live/Live.js NAV, first entry). It is harmless, but it is a self-link.
NavCheck skips every `tasks/` folder, so a new task-module page that nothing links to passes. This is documented and a reasonable call.
The owner asked for a Merge link on `AISessionDetail.js`, which is added with a plain `a`. The count pill is only on the dashboard and the sessions page. That matches "if cheap".
